methodology: All 21 current bladder-neck MDX pages were read in full before editing. This incremental ledger records saved corrections separately from fully read pages still awaiting correction. Primary abstracts, selected full-text sections and current official guidelines/labeling verify consequential claims; no full clinical sign-off is asserted. Uncontrolled technique reports are retained only for scoped operative evidence, not as practice-changing ranking evidence. Other surgical domains outside the original urethral/upper-tract ledger remain unread unless recorded by another reviewer.
